profile.headline: Senior Staff Software Engineer | Cloud Architecture (AWS) | AI Platform Engineering | GenAI | Distributed Systems
profile.summary:
I’m an Engineering Director and AI Architect passionate about building scalable, intelligent systems that empower people and organizations.

Over the past 17+ years, I’ve designed and led engineering teams across web, cloud, and AI ecosystems — from large-scale enterprise platforms to purpose-driven products like BluePal, an AI autism support app born from my personal journey as a parent.

At Concertiv, I drive our technical vision, integrating cloud, data, and AI to improve efficiency, decision-making, and client impact across our services. My focus is on applying AI with purpose — not to replace humans, but to augment intelligence and enable better outcomes.

I believe in lifelong learning, collaboration, and using technology to build meaningful change.

positions.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Leading the engineering productization of an AI memory platform for enterprise applications. Building scalable cloud infrastructure, production-grade systems, developer tooling, automated testing, and platform capabilities to transform advanced AI research into enterprise-ready products.
positions.insights: Skills: Python · FastAPI · PostgreSQL · Pydantic · pdfplumber · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Pulumi · Docker · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · LlamaIndex · CrewAI · LangChain · LangGraph · Knowledge Graphs · Machine Learning · Director level · Jira

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Principal Software Engineer leading architecture, engineering execution, and AI-driven product capabilities at Cape. Focused on building scalable, production-grade systems where AI, cloud architecture, and engineering excellence intersect.

Key responsibilities and focus areas:
- Technical leadership across backend, frontend, platform, devops, and AI/GenAI systems
- Designing and scaling AI Agentic Systems and RAG architectures, intelligent document pipelines, and agentic workflows
- Defining cloud-native architectures with strong emphasis on reliability, security, and cost efficiency
- Driving engineering best practices: code quality, testing, automation, CI/CD, and observability
- Partnering closely with Product to translate complex problems into scalable, reusable solutions
- Mentoring engineers and elevating technical standards across the team

Core technologies & platforms:
Python, FastAPI, Pydantic, SQLAlchemy, PostgreSQL, LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, RAG systems, AI Agents, Cloud Architecture (AWS/Azure), DevOps, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code
positions.insights: Skills: FastAPI · AI Agents · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · LlamaIndex · LangGraph · Python · PostgreSQL · Pydantic · Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Infrastructure as code (IaC) · React · LangChain · API Development

positions.title: Cloud Engineer / Founder
positions.description:
Senior Developer, Engineer and Architect. Cloud, Web and Mobile apps, more than 20 years of working in active software development world. Work mostly with opensource technologies and try always to be up-to-date learning new technologies, libraries, frameworks and software development best practices which help me to obtain better results in the completion of projects and the full satisfaction of our customers.

Founded my small startup software company which provides services to third party companies which request professional services for software, consulting, architecting and engineering. Currently working in multiple applications (web apps and mobile apps) for multiple companies and bringing them consulting and services for different sectors of society: Economy, Accounting, Energy Savings, Real Estate, Electronic Commerce, Financial, etc. Love Teamwork and currently working with a team of developers all remotely who collaborate actively and efficiently in each of the applications on a daily basis. Work in all current projects as an Architect, Engineer, Technical Lead, Full Stack Developer and sometimes as a Scrum Master organizing software development teams.

High level in management of software development teams. Domain and real uses cases designing and implementing Machine Learning (AI) algorithms and neural networks. Application and domain of SCRUM methodologies. Design and implementation of web and mobile applications. High domain of REST APIs, and architectures like Microservices, Event-driven architecture, Serverless. Main programming language: PYTHON. Main technologies, cloud resources and frameworks: Django/DRF/Postgresql/Mysql/Vuejs/Javascript/JQuery/Vuetify/Bootstrap/Docker/Flutter/Github/Bitbucket/GitLab/AWS/Lambda/Dynamo/StepFunction/S3/AWS SAM/Terraform/ECS/EC2/RDS/Linux/Bash/Machine Learning
positions.insights: Skills: Large Language Models (LLM) · API Development · Metodologías ágiles · Transferencia de Estado Representacional (REST) · Desarrollo de software · Git · AI Agents · LangChain · Generative AI · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Director of Engineering
positions.description:
As the Director of Engineering at Concertiv, I play a pivotal role in driving the company's technical vision and engineering excellence. I lead a dynamic team of engineers, overseeing the development and deployment of robust, scalable solutions that empower both our employees and clients.

One of my key achievements at Concertiv is being a founding member of the team that developed a new web application designed to manage the diverse domains Concertiv operates within. This platform has become an essential tool, streamlining operations and enhancing the efficiency of both internal teams and client interactions.

In my role, I:
    - Lead Engineering Teams: Manage and mentor engineering teams, fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
    - Architect Solutions: Design and implement cloud-based architectures, utilizing AWS and modern development frameworks to create event-driven and microservices-based systems.
    - Drive AI Integration: Spearhead the integration of AI technologies, including Generative AI, into our solutions, leveraging frameworks like LlamaIndex to enhance data retrieval and decision-making processes.
    - Ensure Infrastructure Excellence: Oversee the implementation of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices using CDKTF, ensuring our infrastructure is automated, scalable, and resilient.

My focus is on delivering high-quality, scalable solutions that meet Concertiv's strategic goals. I'm passionate about creating tools that not only solve complex problems but also drive value for our employees and clients.

The tech stack at Concertiv includes a robust combination of tools and technologies: Python, Django, DRF (Django REST Framework), React.js, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, PostgreSQL, AWS: EC2, ALB, TG, S3, Cloudfront, Lambdas, SNS, Chatbot, Bedrock, SES, etc. IaC:  CDKTF (CDK for Terraform), AI (RAG): LlamaIndex,  VCS: Git, GitHub, CI/CD: AWS CodePipeline, CodeBuild, CodeDeploy
positions.insights: Skills: Large Language Models (LLM) · Django REST framework · API Development · PostgreSQL · Python · Django · AI Agents · LangChain · Generative AI · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Senior Software Architect  and Engineer
positions.description: Bilingual Educational platform using Python and Django. Database modelling according to the processes to be developed, achieving a better efficiency and effectiveness in the diagramming of tables and relationships using PostgreSQL as a database manager. Creation of APIs (using Django REST) for different processes like: user authentication (OAuth2), endpoints related with functionalities and direct interaction with Games (Unity). Integration with Facebook and Google APIs. Working with different Python's libraries and Django's libraries for different functionalities like: convert videos extension from .mov to mp4,  record voices, upload images and videos, optimizations in querysets, validations, testing and others.  Design of the new architectures for development and production in AWS. Configuration of a new architecture that it will allow us to become the actual design to MicroServices architecture in a future.  Organization and planning of each of the tasks and processes to be performed, setting priorities according to the guidelines of our CEO. Management of each modeling,  methodologies and best practices working together with all the teams:  Back-end, Front-end, Mobile and Game developers.

positions.title: Contract Software Developer
positions.description:
Designed and implemented a Software Accounting and Financial using Python, Django and Django REST framework. Implemented a backend project with APIs: Resources, View Sets, JSON Serializers and using PostgreSQL as database manager. 

I developed the automation of an accounting process to several private and public companies. The project also included the automation of fixed assets, human resources management and inventories, with dynamics statistics and reports using some JavaScript libraries such as HighChartJS, JQuery and Google Chart Tools

positions.description:

Generates dynamic pdf files and also generate real-time statistics designed with High charts JavaScript library. In addition, the use of Html5 API drag and drop and others components into the modules where a dynamic web system was needed.

positions.title: Software Developer and Engineer	(Fulltime)
positions.description:
Designed embedded systems software by applying key principles of computer science, engineering and mathematical analysis. 

Designed, implemented and configured an Academic Management Software which manages all the academics, administrative and financial process of a higher education institution or colleges. 

The application was developed using Python and Django framework. It works also with Postgresql relational database manager, and its user interface are in Html5/CSS3/JavaScript, using JQuery framework and others JavaScript libraries to different dynamics components in frontend that it becomes the platform more friendly and intuitive to the user.

In the development of the application and its implementation we work all the time in a team environment, using different methodologies like Scrum for a faster and more effective development. Also we used TDD for test and checks of each processes. 

Its controls everything related to an educational center, and assists control, assessments, curricula, schedules, academic standards, syllabus, download duties and tasks, all automated, including teacher secretary work is also implemented in the system.

One of the greatest achievements is that the application it has been implemented and is currently working in several prestigious colleges and more than a dozen of higher education institutions in Ecuador
